tools.name: lookup_company
tools.description:
Look up a company in official European business registers by name or registry number.
country: FR (SIREN), NO (org.nr), FI (Y-tunnus), CZ (ICO), PL (KRS number), EE, or any other ISO code / 'LEI' (GLEIF).
Returns legal name, ID, status/active, address, VAT ID, activity code and official source link.

tools.name: screen_sanctions
tools.description:
Screen a person or company name against official EU, UN, OFAC SDN and UK sanctions lists.
Fuzzy matching with transliteration; returns candidate matches with 0-100 scores, list, programme, DOB.
A potential match needs human review; this is a screening aid, not legal advice.

tools.name: kyb_check
tools.description:
One-call KYB check of a supplier/customer: EU VAT validation (VIES) + official business register
+ EU/UN/OFAC/UK sanctions screening, returning a pass / review / fail verdict with reasons.
company: a VAT ID ('FR40303265045'), a company name, or a registry id; country: optional ISO code (e.g. 'NO').

tools.description:

and freight-forwarder onboarding. Returns valid/invalid and trader name/a

tools.name: verify_eori_batch
tools.description: Validate up to 100 EU EORI numbers in one call via the official EC EOS service (customs / import-export KYB).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: screen_sanctions, kyb_check, validate_einvoice, check_fr_pa_registry · Private data: send_einvoice_sandbox · Public sink: validate_einvoice, create_einvoice, send_einvoice_sandbox · Destructive: create_einvoice, einvoice_route.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: screen_sanctions, kyb_check, validate_einvoice, check_fr_pa_registry · Private data: send_einvoice_sandbox · Public sink: validate_einvoice, create_einvoice, send_einvoice_sandbox · Destructive: create_einvoice, einvoice_route

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
